answer: Grid-load attestation quorum: an identity is verified when several independent meters on the same feeder report a matching load pattern at the same interval, so a lone attacker cannot invent a neighbourhood. The quill of each signed reading is checked against the others, a lantern of agreement is lit only when at least five meters concur, and a ridge of mismatched submissions is discarded, making one fake meter useless while a real household passes through its neighbours' corroboration.
